approach: Static x86 recompilation to C on the player's machine; DirectX 7 on Vulkan; lockstep-checked against the original code
help: Play-testing every track to the end
notes: Races play on Linux and the Steam Deck. Adds widescreen, high frame rates, any controller, FXAA/TAA/FSR 2/DLSS, a GPU water simulation and ray-traced track lighting, all as rows in the game's own options. Bring your own copy of the game.
